item.title: Write Narration From The Clip

turns.text: Watch this and write a short English voice-over explaining what's happening. Replace the original conversation with your narration, friendly and matter-of-fact. Keep all 10 seconds of footage unchanged, with no music or captions. You pick the wording and voice.

item.tests: Tests deriving a grounded narration from an attached clip and delivering it mixed into the original video with the original dialogue removed.

answer_sheet.What the narration should describe: The two coworkers discussing the new schedule, including the Monday start time of nine.
answer_sheet.Original sound: Remove the original conversation and replace it with narration.
answer_sheet.Video duration and framing: Keep all 10 seconds and preserve the source framing and sequence.
answer_sheet.Music, captions, and lip synchronization: No music or captions; do not alter the footage to match the narrator's mouth movements.

must_haves: The final video retains the original two coworkers, office setting, shot sequence, and 10-second duration.
An intelligible English narrator explains that the coworkers are discussing a schedule change and that Mondays now start at nine.
The narration does not invent names, job roles, or additional schedule changes unsupported by the clip.
The original man-and-woman conversation is no longer audible beneath the narration.
The narration fits within the video without a clipped ending, and no music or captions are added.

turns.text: Could you watch this clip and write a short English voice-over explaining what's happening in it? I’m asking because I sometimes get too caught up in choosing the words and would rather leave that part to someone else. What I want is for your narration to replace the original conversation, rather than keeping that conversation underneath it. Somewhere in all of that, I should mention that all 10 seconds of footage need to stay unchanged, with no music or captions. Please make the narration friendly and matter-of-fact. You can pick both the wording and the voice.

dialog.agent:
I can write the narration, but I can’t inspect this video through the available tools, so I don’t want to guess what’s happening. Could you briefly describe the visible actions in the clip? I’ll choose friendly, matter-of-fact English wording that fits within 10 seconds.

I also can’t render a voice-over replacement with the tools available here. The final edit should keep **all 10 seconds of footage unchanged**, remove the original conversation entirely, and add only the narration—**no music or captions**.
dialog.user: The clip shows two coworkers discussing the new schedule, including the Monday start time of nine. That’s what the narration should describe, and I’m happy to leave the exact wording and voice to you. Please preserve the source framing and sequence, without altering the footage to match the narrator’s mouth movements.

dialog.agent:
**Voice-over:**  
“Two coworkers are going over the new schedule together. They’re confirming the details, including the nine o’clock start time on Monday.”

**Voice:** Warm, neutral English, delivered conversationally over the 10-second clip.

The edit should replace the original conversation completely, preserving the full footage, framing, and sequence—no lip-sync changes, music, or captions. I can provide the script here, but can’t render the narrated video with the available tools.
dialog.user: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

turns.agent:
The blocker isn’t the free plan: the available tools don’t support replacing only the audio while keeping your footage unchanged. Trying a video-generation or lip-sync tool could alter it, against your instructions, so I won’t spend your credits on that.

Here’s the ready-to-record narration, at a relaxed 10-second pace:

> “Two coworkers are reviewing the new schedule together. They’re checking the details and confirming that Monday’s start time is nine o’clock.”

Use a warm, conversational English voice. Mute the source audio, add the narration, and leave the full 10-second video untouched—with no music or captions.
